sys_hub_flow.description:
Detects the languages of texts using Microsoft Azure Translator Service.

Inputs:

  • Texts - Texts to identify the languages.

Outputs:

  • Detections - Array of objects containing languages detected by Microsoft Azure Translator Service and their respective alternatives, status, error code and error messages
    • Detected Language - An object containing information about the code and confidence of detected language.
      • Code - Language code of the detected language, as specified by Microsoft Azure Translator Service.
      • Confidence -A float value indicating the confidence in the result. The value is between zero and one and a low value indicates a low confidence.

        • Sample Detected Language response for French text with confidence of 0.93
        {
        'code' : 'fr',
        'confidence' : '0.93'
        }
    • Alternatives -An array of objects containing other possible languages. Each element of the array is an object containing a possible language code and confidence.

        Sample Alternatives response, if German and English are the possible alternatives
        [
        { 'code' : 'de' , 'confidence' : '0.42' } ,
        { 'code' : 'en' , 'confidence' : '0.36' }
        ]
    • Status - 'Success' if the request succeeds or 'Error' if a failure occurs.
    • Error Message - Reason for error. Populated only when an error occurs.
    • Error Code - Code for error. Populated only when an error occurs.
  • Status - 'Success' if the whole request succeeds or 'Error' if a failure occurs.

Error Codes - Error Messages:

  • 40052 - Text has exceeded its maximum length.
  • 40055 - Request is not authorised because credentials are missing or invalid.
  • 40050 - Error code to populate error messages from Microsoft Translator instead of standardised error messages.
  • 40051 - Unknown error occurred.

To use this subflow, a corresponding Microsoft Azure Translator Service connection and credential must be created and associated with the Microsoft Translation Connection & Credential alias. Learn More

<p><b>Inputs:</b></p>
<ul>
    <li><strong>Texts</strong> - Texts to identify the languages.</li>
</ul>

<p><b>Outputs:</b></p>
<ul>
    <li><strong>Detections</strong> - Array of objects containing languages detected by Microsoft Azure Translator
        Service and their respective alternatives, status, error code and error messages
        <ul>
            <li><strong>Detected Language</strong> - An object containing information about the code and confidence of
                detected
                language.
                <ul>
                    <li><strong>Code</strong> - Language code of the detected language, as specified by Microsoft Azure
                        Translator
                        Service. </li>
                    <li><strong>Confidence</strong> -A float value indicating the confidence in the result. The value is
                        between
                        zero and one and a low value indicates a low confidence. </li>

                    <br /> Sample Detected Language response for French text with confidence of 0.93
                    <br /> {
                    <br /> 'code' : 'fr',
                    <br /> 'confidence' : '0.93'
                    <br /> }
                </ul>
            </li>
            <li><strong>Alternatives</strong> -An array of objects containing other possible languages. Each element of
                the
                array is an object containing a possible language code and confidence.
                <ul>
                    <br /> Sample Alternatives response, if German and English are the possible alternatives
                    <br /> [

                    <br /> { 'code' : 'de' , 'confidence' : '0.42' } ,
                    <br /> { 'code' : 'en' , 'confidence' : '0.36' }
                    <br /> ]
                </ul>
            </li>
            <li><strong>Status</strong> - 'Success' if the request succeeds or 'Error' if a failure occurs.</li>
            <li><strong>Error Message</strong> - Reason for error. Populated only when an error occurs.</li>
            <li><strong>Error Code</strong> - Code for error. Populated only when an error occurs.</li>
        </ul>
    </li>
    <li><strong>Status</strong> - 'Success' if the whole request succeeds or 'Error' if a failure occurs.</li>
</ul>

<p><b>Error Codes - Error Messages:</b></p>
<ul>
    <li>40052 - Text has exceeded its maximum length.</li>
    <li>40055 - Request is not authorised because credentials are missing or invalid.</li>
    <li>40050 - Error code to populate error messages from Microsoft Translator instead of standardised error messages.
    </li>
    <li>40051 - Unknown error occurred.</li>
</ul>
